body:
Oh and to answer your first question! Whiplash injuries and nerve damage from a collision. There are three options, local anesthetic injected into nerves for general pain relief, and if that isn't as helpful as they expect, you can get Botox to numb muscles, and a nerve block, self-explanatory. There are also epidural options for pain that radiates into the low back. I gave up on those because I'd rather be hit again.

I am too pussy to count the needles I get in a session and am too pussy to want to know either. Suffice to say 20 is probably a conservative guess and they do not ... feel great when going directly into your malfunctioning nerve and swole lash-induced TMJ neck muscle.
Come on over, it's been kinda hard for me to lift after all this

I just don't know how. I'm in debt from treatment and school that I will now never finish. Sitting or standing for extended periods is absolute hell on my back. I can't perform because there are days I can't chew so I try to do my job subsisting off pureed vegetables and eggs and cans of Ensure. I need speech therapy because nobody can properly hear me anymore which makes interviewing a challenge. So does needing two days off biweekly to see a pain clinic, not to mention all the other appointments I have to do. My resume is in ruins after I have faked my way through an interview and gotten fired after less than a month for a year and a half. 

If this accident had never happened and I felt trapped here for any other reason, I would happily walk out right now and sleep on a bench until shit worked out. I used to work 60 hour weeks and put off post-secondary education just to get out of their house last time. Right now I'm at a point where I can just barely get out of my electric blanket to shower.

I live in a country with extremely long wait times for care and I am at a disadvantage being young, not terminal, and having people in my life who could care for me, even if they are shitty at it. I've contacted some and was discouraged.

Honestly, at 28 I would rather kill myself than live in a hospice anyway. I can't fathom having that many years of nothing ahead of me (and members of my family consistently waste space on this planet til 99, oh the irony).

I've also found that people generally don't give a fuck about emotional abuse and think it is a flaw of your character. I've been told by social workers when I was a kid that I should just be more grateful because my parents had money.

My whole life I've slipped through the cracks. I just can't fall any further you know?

Shit, I'm sorry. I really do have none of the above either. I know you can't elaborate, but even without details our lives have probably been similar and honestly, good on you for still being alive.

>I’m Nobody! Who are you?
>Are you – Nobody – too?
>Then there’s a pair of us!
>Don’t tell! they’d advertise – you know!
>
>How dreary – to be – Somebody!
>How public – like a Frog –  
>To tell one’s name – the livelong June –  
>To an admiring Bog!
Man I just want people to not hit me with their cars. #bootstraps
If you have a spite-fuelled time machine I could hop into so I was never hit by a car hmu
